topic: Hunter class in World of Warcraft: Forever (pets, specs, abilities, talents, rotations, leveling, group and PvP role)
overview: In Forever (launch Nov 4, 2026 per Icy Veins; level cap 60; beta ran Sep 17 to ~Oct 22, capped at 20 and then 30), the Hunter keeps its Classic base: Auto Shot, the 8-yard dead zone, ammo, stings, aspects, Feign Death and traps placed at your own feet. Its resource is still Mana with the 5-second rule. Pets use Focus, which now regenerates continuously. Blizzard's official Sept 30 deep dive lists these changes: Aimed Shot is baseline for every Hunter at level 20 and shares a cooldown with Multi-Shot, while Arcane Shot no longer does. Traps work in combat on a 30 s cooldown, and Fire and Frost traps have separate cooldowns. Disengage removes twice as much threat. Aspect of the Beast now adds melee Attack Power. Scorpid Sting now lowers hit chance by 2%. Pets scale with the Hunter's gear. Guides put this at 10% of the Hunter's highest AP, 100% of crit, 30% of armor and 2 HP per Stamina. In return, pets can no longer take other players' stat buffs. Every pet family gets one unique ability, and Foxes are a new family with Trickster's Dance. Loyalty, happiness, taming at level 10 and learning higher ranks by taming beasts that know them all remain. Later beta notes made Auto Shot need 0.5 s of standing still again, though it keeps firing during Aimed Shot and Sniper Shot casts. They also made Trueshot Aura raid-wide and let one Fire trap and one Frost trap be active at once. Spec identities are now clearer. Beast Mastery stays the pet spec and adds Summon Hawk (16-point talent; up to 2 temporary hawks; shares a cooldown with Arcane Shot) and Focused Fire. Marksmanship is the ranged spec, with an optional no-pet path through Lone Wolf (11-point, +20% damage with no pet). It adds Careful Aim (Intellect becomes AP), Rapid Killing, Rapid Recuperation, a raid-wide Trueshot Aura and the 31-point Sniper Shot (4 s cast, 15 s cooldown, 45 yd). Survival is now a trap and dual-wield melee spec, built on Savage Strikes, Predator's Edge, Strider Kick (21-point), Expose Prey (Mongoose Bite without needing a dodge), Resourcefulness and Lacerating Strikes (31-point bleed). Wyvern Sting is gone. Blizzard states Hunters "cannot Stun or Interrupt" (pet Intimidation aside) and can only deal damage. Every level-60 rotation published so far is theory, because the beta stopped at 30.

specs.name: Beast Mastery
specs.identity: Your pet does most of the damage and tanks in the open world. Pets scale with Hunter gear (10% AP, 100% crit), and Summon Hawk adds up to two temporary hawk 'pseudo-pets' that Unleashed Fury and Ferocity also buff. Bestial Wrath (+50% pet damage, CC immunity, 2 min) is the capstone and the burst window. Guides call it the easiest Hunter spec and the strongest leveling spec in the game. Its weaknesses are heavy pet dependency (pets and hawks dying to raid AoE) and, per Wowhead, little group utility.
keyNewTalents: Summon Hawk (new 16-point gold medal)
Focused Fire (new, +1/2% you and pet damage)
Deadly Aspects (renamed Improved Aspect of the Hawk; adds melee procs in Aspect of the Beast)
Endurance Training (Thick Hide merged: pet Health+Armor)
Improved Aspect of the Monkey (pet gets 50%)
Unleashed Fury / Ferocity (now also buff hawks; values lowered)
Improved Mend Pet (now also cuts Mend Pet mana cost)
Intimidation (now +100% crit on the stun attack; requires Bestial Swiftness)
Bestial Discipline (now also 25/50% mana regen while casting)
specs.level60Rotation: THEORETICAL (Warcraft Tavern, beta capped at 30). Single target: 1) Pre-place Immolation Trap at the tank spot. 2) Pre-cast Aimed Shot into the pull, then use it on cooldown. 3) Serpent Sting, reapplied when it expires. 4) Summon Hawk on cooldown to keep 2 hawks up. 5) Aimed Shot on cooldown. 6) Arcane Shot only when 2 hawks are up with 6+ s left. 7) Rapid Fire and Bestial Wrath on cooldown. AoE: pre-placed Explosive Trap, Multi-Shot instead of Aimed Shot, Serpent Sting on every target, keep hawks up, Explosive Trap on cooldown, then cooldowns. Wowhead's level-30 loop: Hawk, Aimed, Hawk, Aimed, Arcane, Aimed, repeat. Icy Veins (level 30): Hunter's Mark, send pet, Serpent Sting, Summon Hawk keeping 2 up, Aimed Shot on cooldown, Auto Shot, Disengage if you pull aggro, Arcane Shot only if mana-capped with hawks covered. Complexity: Warcraft Tavern calls it 'relatively straightforward' and Wowhead 'most likely the easiest to play'. The main skill is keeping two hawks rolling without refreshing early, plus pet control.
specs.rotationStatus: reported-guide; level-60 version theoretical (Warcraft Tavern 31/20/0 build); Icy Veins and Wowhead only cover level 30

specs.name: Marksmanship
specs.role: Ranged DPS (own shots; optional petless via Lone Wolf); raid-wide Trueshot Aura
specs.identity: The lone archer or gunner. Damage comes from your own shots, scaling through Lethal Attacks, Careful Aim (Int to AP), Mortal Shots, Barrage (now includes Aimed Shot) and Improved Stings. Lone Wolf gives +20% damage with no active pet, aimed at endgame PvE. Leveling guides still recommend keeping the pet. Sniper Shot is a 4 s cast, 15 s cooldown, 45 yd burst shot. Icy Veins suspects it may lose DPS in PvE, and forum testers call it weak. Guides give it the highest Hunter AoE in dungeons. It is mana-hungry, depends on positioning, and suffers most from the dead zone.
keyNewTalents: Lone Wolf (new 11-point gold medal: +20% damage without pet)
Careful Aim (new: AP = 20-100% of Intellect)
Rapid Killing (new: Rapid Fire -1/2 min; next Shot +10/20% after a kill)
Rapid Recuperation (new: mana regen while casting after Serpent Sting)
Improved Stings (replaces Improved Serpent Sting; also Viper/Scorpid)
Lethal Attacks (formerly Lethal Shots; crit for all attacks)
Trueshot Aura (moved up; ranged AP only; raid-wide since Oct 16 build)
Sniper Shot (new 31-point gold medal)
Barrage (now includes Aimed Shot, lower bonus)
specs.level60Rotation: THEORETICAL (Warcraft Tavern 5/46/0, beta capped at 30). Single target: 1) Pre-place Immolation Trap. 2) Pre-cast Sniper Shot into the pull, then use it on cooldown. 3) Serpent Sting, reapplied on expiry. 4) Aimed Shot on cooldown. 5) Arcane Shot on cooldown. 6) Rapid Fire on cooldown. AoE: pre-placed Explosive Trap, Multi-Shot on cooldown, Serpent Sting on every target, Sniper Shot, Arcane Shot, Explosive Trap on cooldown, Rapid Fire. Icy Veins leveling: open with Sniper Shot while the Rapid Killing buff is up, and keep Serpent Sting on targets so they die with it. Wowhead level 30: Serpent Sting, then Arcane Shot plus Aimed Shot (or Multi-Shot) on cooldown. Complexity: Warcraft Tavern calls it 'relatively straightforward'. Wowhead calls it 'most likely the hardest to play' of the three, but 'not a hard spec at all' in groups. Mana management matters because of Aimed Shot and Sniper Shot costs.
specs.rotationStatus: reported-guide; level-60 theoretical; Sniper Shot value in PvE disputed (Icy Veins: 'possible ... damage loss in PvE')

specs.name: Survival
specs.role: Melee DPS (dual-wield or 2H melee, with traps and optional ranged weaving)
specs.identity: Reworked from Classic's disruption/PvP tree into a melee spec. Savage Strikes, Predator's Edge (+50% off-hand damage) and Lightning Reflexes support melee. Raptor Strike, Mongoose Bite (made reliable by Expose Prey on your Hunter's Mark target), Strider Kick and Counterattack are the melee buttons, and Lacerating Strikes adds a bleed. Traps get stronger (Entrapment always roots; Clever Traps; Survivalist's Discipline -40% trap cooldown). Blizzard frames it as 'trap or melee-oriented build options' and players who 'dance back and forth between ranged and melee'. Survival is the weakest early leveling spec, because melee talents sit deep in the tree; guides expect you to play ranged until about level 30-40. It has little AoE beyond Explosive Trap and competes with Warriors and Rogues for weapons.
keyNewTalents: Strider Kick (new 21-point gold medal: 100% weapon damage, +30% speed 3 s, 8 s cooldown; not an interrupt)
Lacerating Strikes (new 31-point gold medal: Mongoose Bite bleed)
Expose Prey (new: Mongoose Bite usable via Hunter's Mark target procs)
Predator's Edge (new: melee crit damage + off-hand damage)
Resourcefulness (new: -30/60% trap and melee mana; mana regen on ability crits)
Survivalist's Discipline (new: -20/40% Trap and Deterrence cooldown)
Improved Tracking (merges Monster/Humanoid Slaying)
Savage Strikes (redesigned to all melee abilities)
Entrapment (always triggers)
Counterattack (now the 16-point gold medal; weapon-damage based)
Survival Tactics (formerly Trap Mastery; adds Feign Death hit)
specs.level60Rotation: UNKNOWN at 60. No level-60 Survival rotation has been published; Warcraft Tavern has no Survival spec guide. Icy Veins level 30 melee: Hunter's Mark, send pet, Serpent Sting, run in and use Raptor Strike on cooldown, Mongoose Bite whenever available, Strider Kick on cooldown, Disengage if you pull aggro. Wowhead level 30: queue Raptor Strike in melee; Mongoose Bite > Strider Kick > Counterattack; use Strider Kick's speed to step out and weave Arcane Shot, Serpent Sting and Aimed Shot until the melee cooldowns return. Warcraft Tavern offers 'melee weave' and 'melee only' variants that add Immolation Trap on cooldown and an Aspect of the Beast or Hawk choice. Complexity: Warcraft Tavern calls it 'a considerably more involved rotation'; Wowhead says 'you will probably always have a button to press'.
specs.rotationStatus: reported-guide (level 30 only); level-60 unknown; forum sims (beta-observation) disagree on whether weaving or pure melee is optimal

abilities.name: Auto Shot
abilities.castTime: must stand still 0.5 s before shooting (restored in Oct 16 build)
abilities.description: Automatically shoots the target until cancelled (8-35 yd). Forever: requires standing still for 0.5 s ('matching early versions'). Your character keeps firing Auto Shot while casting Aimed Shot or Sniper Shot. Icy Veins says abilities do not clip Auto Shot. An early-beta bug that made it near-instant was fixed. A new option auto-switches between Auto Attack and Auto Shot.

abilities.name: Raptor Strike
abilities.description: 'A strong attack that deals melee weapon damage plus 5' (R1), up to +70 at R8. Survival's main melee button; other specs use it for weaving.

abilities.name: Tracking (Track Beasts/Humanoids/Undead/Hidden/Elementals/Demons/Giants/Dragonkin)
abilities.description: Learned at levels 1 (Beasts), 10 (Humanoids), 18 (Undead), 24 (Hidden), 26 (Elementals), 32 (Demons), 40 (Giants) and 50 (Dragonkin). Shows that creature type on the minimap; only one can be active at a time. Track Hidden raises stealth detection. Datamine shows them unchanged from Classic, but with the Survival talent Improved Tracking they add 1-5% damage against the tracked type.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Monkey
abilities.description: Raises dodge chance by 8%; only one Aspect active at a time. Datamine shows its range changed to 100 yd (instead of self). The BM talent Improved Aspect of the Monkey adds +2/4/6% dodge and gives the pet 50% of the effect.

abilities.name: Serpent Sting
abilities.description: 'Stings the target, causing 10 Nature damage over 15 sec' (R1), up to 555 over 15 s at R9. Per-rank values are 15-50% lower than Classic, but Wowhead says it now scales slightly with AP. One Sting per Hunter per target. Feeds the MM talents Rapid Killing and Rapid Recuperation; Improved Stings adds up to +20%.

abilities.name: Arcane Shot
abilities.description: 'An instant shot that causes 20 Arcane damage' (R1), 217 at R8; values raised over Classic and it scales slightly with RAP (Wowhead). Official: no longer shares a cooldown with Aimed Shot, but shares its cooldown with the BM talent Summon Hawk. Improved Arcane Shot cuts the cooldown by up to 1.5 s (this does not affect Summon Hawk).

abilities.name: Hunter's Mark
abilities.description: Debuff lasting 2 min at 100 yd: +26 RAP for all attackers (R1), up to +71 at R4 (L58). The target stays visible through stealth and invisibility and appears on the minimap. Official: the Improved Hunter's Mark talent is now baseline. Also triggers Survival's Expose Prey. Rank values are datamined.

abilities.name: Concussive Shot
abilities.description: 'Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.' Datamined as unchanged from Classic. The MM talent Improved Concussive Shot adds a 4-20% chance to stun for 3 s. Guides call it a key PvP and kiting tool.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Hawk
abilities.description: Raises Ranged Attack Power by 20 (R1), up to 120 at R7 (L60); datamine shows the rank 6 value cut 50%. The default ranged DPS aspect. The Deadly Aspects talent gives Auto Shot a chance to proc +30% ranged attack speed for 12 s.

abilities.name: Tame Beast
abilities.description: Unlocked at level 10 through the race-specific class quest chain 'Taming the Beast' (three tames). Your armor is reduced 100% while channeling, and the tame fails if the beast takes damage or loses attention. Official beta fix: it no longer works on beasts above the Hunter's level. You cannot tame while you have an active or dead stabled pet (Warcraft Tavern).

abilities.name: Beast Training
abilities.description: Unlocked by the quest 'Training the Beast' (which also grants Feed Pet and Revive Pet). Spends the pet's Training Points, which grow with loyalty (300 at level 60 with Best Friend loyalty). Pets can have at most 4 active abilities. Learned ranks can be taught to any pet able to learn them; a Pet Trainer can reset trained abilities for a fee.

abilities.name: Call Pet / Dismiss Pet
abilities.description: Summons or dismisses your pet. Dismissing reduces its happiness by 50. Datamined as unchanged.

abilities.name: Feed Pet
abilities.description: Raises happiness; food close to the pet's level works better, and each family has its own diet. Cannot be used in combat. Happiness levels: Happy = 125% damage, Content = 100%, Unhappy = 75% (Warcraft Tavern).

abilities.name: Revive Pet
abilities.description: Revives the pet with 15% health. The BM talent Improved Revive Pet cuts the cast by 6 s and the mana by 40%, and adds +30% health.

abilities.name: Mend Pet
abilities.description: 'Heals your pet 20 health every second while you focus. Lasts 5 sec.' (R1, 7 ranks, 20 yd). Official: the Improved Mend Pet talent now also cuts its mana cost (10/20%), and its 15/50% chance per tick to cleanse 1 Curse, Disease, Magic or Poison effect remains.

abilities.name: Wing Clip
abilities.description: Melee: 5 damage plus a 50% movement slow for 10 s (R1, 3 ranks). The Survival talent Improved Wing Clip gives a 7/13/20% chance to immobilize for 5 s.

abilities.name: Distracting Shot
abilities.description: 'Distract the target, causing threat.' 6 ranks. Guides use it to grab or redirect aggro.

abilities.name: Eagle Eye
abilities.description: Zooms your view onto a distant area at unlimited range, outdoors only, for up to 1 min.

abilities.name: Scare Beast
abilities.description: Fears one beast for up to 10 s (R1, 3 ranks); damage may break it. Guides use it in PvP against Hunter pets and druid animal forms.

abilities.name: Eyes of the Beast
abilities.description: Take direct control of your pet for 2 min (was 1 min). Official: the Improved Eyes of the Beast talent is now baseline. Used for scouting and pulling.

abilities.name: Immolation Trap
abilities.description: A Fire trap that burns the first enemy to approach for 105 Fire damage over 15 s (R1), up to 690 at R5 (L56); the trap lasts 1 min. Official: traps now work in combat, and Fire and Frost traps have separate cooldowns. Oct 16 build: Fire traps scale with AP, and you can have 1 Fire and 1 Frost trap active at once. Still placed only at the Hunter's own location.

abilities.name: Mongoose Bite
abilities.description: 'Counterattack the enemy for melee weapon damage plus 15. Can only be performed after you dodge.' (R1), up to +57 at R4. Now based on weapon damage (was flat). Survival's Expose Prey can enable it without a dodge, and Lacerating Strikes adds a bleed.

abilities.name: Multi-Shot
abilities.description: 'Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets.' Official: it now shares its cooldown with Aimed Shot. Datamine shows a single rank (no damage ranks); guides use it instead of Aimed Shot against 2+ targets.

abilities.name: Aimed Shot
abilities.castTime: 2 sec in latest Wowhead datamine (warcraft.wiki.gg shows 3 sec)
abilities.description: Official: now baseline for all Hunters at level 20 (was an MM talent) and shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot. 'An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 20' (R1), +166 at R6; per-rank values are about 71-73% lower than Classic. Auto Shot keeps firing during the cast. Ranks: R2 L28, R3 L36, R4 L44, R6 L60. Barrage now affects it.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Cheetah
abilities.description: +30% movement speed; if you take damage you are dazed for 4 s. Can be toggled in combat. Pathfinding adds +6%. Guides call it the main mobility before mounts, which they say arrive at level 40.

abilities.name: Disengage
abilities.description: Melee range: 'Attempts to disengage from the target by reducing threat. Disables auto-attack.' Official: threat reduction doubled (in game from the ~Oct 8 build). It is a threat drop, not a leap.

abilities.name: Freezing Trap
abilities.description: A Frost trap that freezes the first enemy to approach for up to 10 s (R1), 20 s at R3 (L60); any damage breaks it. Usable in combat with its own Frost-trap cooldown (official). Clever Traps extends it (+30% duration) and Entrapment roots targets.

abilities.name: Scorpid Sting
abilities.description: Official: now reduces the target's chance to hit by 2% (instead of lowering Strength and Agility). Lasts 20 s; single rank. Improved Stings extends the duration (+15-45 s). Warcraft Tavern: does not stack with Insect Swarm.

abilities.name: Beast Lore
abilities.description: Shows a beast's or a Hunter pet's damage, health, armor, resistances and diet.

abilities.name: Rapid Fire
abilities.description: 'Increases ranged and melee attack speed by 40% for 15 sec' (Classic was ranged only). The main Hunter DPS cooldown for every spec.

abilities.name: Frost Trap
abilities.description: Creates an ice slick for 30 s when the first enemy approaches; enemies within 10 yd are slowed 60%. Usable in combat (official). Beta fix: Entrapment now triggers only on its first activation.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Beast
abilities.description: Official: now also grants melee Attack Power. Datamined: untrackable plus Melee AP +50 (R1), up to +110 at R4 (L60). Deadly Aspects gives melee auto attacks haste procs while it is active. Players note it still arrives only at level 30.

abilities.name: Feign Death
abilities.description: 'Feign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you. Lasts 6 min.' Drops threat, but enemies still attack your pet. Used to escape, reset pulls, gear-swap out of combat, and drop targeting in PvP. Survival Tactics (official) adds hit chance; Improved Feign Death was folded into Resourcefulness.

abilities.name: Flare
abilities.description: 'Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area for 30 sec.' Range 30 yd. An anti-stealth tool.

abilities.name: Explosive Trap
abilities.description: A Fire trap that explodes for 105-135 Fire damage plus 150 over 20 s to all within 10 yd (R1), up to 208-264 plus 330 at R3. Usable in combat and scales with AP (official). Guides name it the main Hunter AoE alongside Multi-Shot and Volley.

abilities.name: Viper Sting
abilities.description: Drains 616 mana over 8 s (R1), 1108 at R3. Datamine adds a 15 s cooldown; Improved Stings cuts it by 2-6 s (official). Useful in PvP against casters.

abilities.name: Volley
abilities.cooldown: none per Wowhead datamine/guide (warcraft.wiki.gg shows 1 min)
abilities.description: Ground-targeted channel: 70 Arcane damage per second to enemies within 8 yd for 6 s (R1; +40% over Classic), 112 per second at R3 (L58). Barrage adds up to +10%.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Pack
abilities.description: Group members within 30 yd gain +30% movement speed; anyone hit is dazed for 4 s. Pathfinding adds +6%.

abilities.name: Aspect of the Wild
abilities.description: You and party/raid members within 30 yd gain +45 Nature resistance (R1), +60 at R2 (L56).

abilities.name: Tranquilizing Shot
abilities.description: Datamined tooltip: 'Attempts to remove 1 Frenzy effect from an enemy creature.' Warcraft Tavern and Icy Veins say it removes Enrage and Frenzy effects and matters in raids. How Forever teaches it is unconfirmed: in Classic it came from a Molten Core tome, and Molten Core is not among Forever's launch raids.

abilities.name: Deadly Aspects
abilities.description: Tier 1, 5 ranks (formerly Improved Aspect of the Hawk). In Aspect of the Hawk, Auto Shot has a 2-10% chance to grant +30% ranged attack speed for 12 s. In Aspect of the Beast, melee auto attacks have the same chance for melee attack speed. Guides call it the best early Hunter talent.

abilities.name: Endurance Training
abilities.description: Tier 1, 5 ranks: +3-15% pet Health and Armor. Thick Hide was merged into it (official).

abilities.name: Focused Fire
abilities.description: New in Forever. Tier 2, 2 ranks: +1/2% to all damage you and your pet deal while the pet is active. Replaces Improved Eyes of the Beast.

abilities.name: Improved Aspect of the Monkey
abilities.description: Tier 2, 3 ranks (was 5): +2/4/6% dodge on Aspect of the Monkey, and the pet gains 50% of the effect. Official wording: 'twice as much Dodge'.

abilities.name: Pathfinding
abilities.description: Tier 2 (moved up from row 3), 2 ranks: +3/6% speed on Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack.

abilities.name: Improved Revive Pet
abilities.description: Tier 2, 2 ranks: Revive Pet casts 3/6 s faster, costs 20/40% less mana, and the pet returns with +15/30% health.

abilities.name: Bestial Swiftness
abilities.description: Tier 3, 1 rank: +30% pet movement speed. The tooltip no longer says 'outdoor'. Required for Intimidation.

abilities.name: Unleashed Fury
abilities.description: Tier 3, 5 ranks: +3-15% damage for pets and hawks (Classic: 20% for pets only).

abilities.name: Improved Mend Pet
abilities.description: Tier 4, 2 ranks: 15/50% chance per heal to cleanse 1 Curse, Disease, Magic or Poison from the pet, and now also cuts Mend Pet's mana cost by 10/20%. A beta bug that raised the cost instead was fixed on Oct 16.

abilities.name: Ferocity
abilities.description: Tier 4, 5 ranks: +2-10% crit chance for pets and hawks (Classic: 15% for pets only).

abilities.name: Summon Hawk
abilities.cost: 80 Mana R1 (datamined); 105 Mana R2 (L36); 190 Mana R4 (L60)
abilities.description: New 16-point gold medal talent; reachable at level 20 with Legacy points. 'Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing 32 [+5% RAP] Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 seconds. Only 2 hawks can be active at once.' Range 35 yd. The hawk spawns at and sticks to its target (Oct 16 fix); Wowhead says it acts like a guardian that can move to the next target and has very little health. Buffed by Unleashed Fury and Ferocity. Players report the mana cost as high.

abilities.name: Spirit Bond
abilities.description: Tier 5, 2 ranks: while your pet is active, you and the pet regenerate 1% of total health every 10/5 s.

abilities.name: Intimidation
abilities.description: Tier 5, 1 rank; now requires Bestial Swiftness. 'Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 seconds on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.' Range 100 yd. Guides use it as a pet stun, a quasi-interrupt and a threat tool.

abilities.name: Bestial Discipline
abilities.description: Tier 5, 2 ranks: +10/20% pet Focus regeneration, and 25/50% of your mana regeneration continues while casting (the mana part is new; official).

abilities.name: Frenzy
abilities.description: Tier 6, 5 ranks (requires 5 in Ferocity): after a crit, the pet has a 20-100% chance to gain +30% attack speed for 8 s. Datamined as unchanged from Classic.

abilities.name: Bestial Wrath
abilities.description: Tier 7, 1 rank (BM capstone; requires Intimidation): 'Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec ... it cannot be stopped unless killed.' Guides note pet CC immunity during it. Datamined as unchanged.

abilities.name: Hawk Eye
abilities.description: Moved from row 3 to row 1 (official); 3 ranks: +2/4/6 yd ranged weapon range.

abilities.name: Improved Concussive Shot
abilities.description: Tier 1, 5 ranks: Concussive Shot gains a 4-20% chance to stun for 3 s. Its proc chance was corrected in the Oct 8 build.

abilities.name: Lethal Attacks
abilities.description: Formerly Lethal Shots; moved up to row 1. 5 ranks: +1-5% crit chance with all attacks (melee included).

abilities.name: Improved Stings
abilities.description: Formerly Improved Serpent Sting; moved up to row 2. 3 ranks: Serpent Sting +6-20% damage, Viper Sting cooldown -2/4/6 s, Scorpid Sting duration +15/30/45 s.

abilities.name: Efficiency
abilities.description: Moved down to row 2. 5 ranks: -3-15% mana cost for Shots, Stings and melee abilities (Classic: 10%, Shots and Stings only).

abilities.name: Careful Aim
abilities.description: New. 5 ranks: melee and ranged Attack Power increased by 20/40/60/80/100% of your Intellect. Required for Mortal Shots.

abilities.name: Rapid Killing
abilities.description: New. 2 ranks: Rapid Fire cooldown -1/2 min. When you kill a non-trivial enemy, or it dies while affected by your Serpent Sting, your next Shot within 20 s deals +10/20% damage.

abilities.name: Improved Arcane Shot
abilities.description: 5 ranks: Arcane Shot cooldown -0.3 to -1.5 s (Classic max 1 s). Does not affect abilities that share its cooldown, such as Summon Hawk.

abilities.name: Lone Wolf
abilities.description: New 11-point gold medal talent: 'You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.' A beta fix removed a -4% penalty while a pet was active. Leveling guides advise against taking it; endgame PvE guides take it.

abilities.name: Trueshot Aura
abilities.description: Moved from row 7 to row 4; Icy Veins shows it requires 15 points, while Blizzard's text calls it the '21-point gold medal'. New lower ranks were added: R1 gives +30 RAP to party/raid members within 45 yd, and the top rank (L60) gives +50 RAP for 30 min. Ranged AP only now (Classic version also gave melee AP). Raid-wide since the Oct 16 build (official).

abilities.name: Mortal Shots
abilities.description: 5 ranks; now requires Careful Aim (official): +6-30% crit damage bonus on all ranged abilities.

abilities.name: Rapid Recuperation
abilities.description: New; requires Rapid Killing. 2 ranks: applying Serpent Sting lets 25/50% of your mana regeneration continue while casting for 15 s, rising to 50/100% when Rapid Killing is consumed. Icy Veins: Rapid Killing plus Rapid Recuperation 'will solve almost all of your mana issues while leveling.'

abilities.name: Barrage
abilities.description: 3 ranks: Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot and Volley deal +3/7/10% damage (Classic: +15% on Multi-Shot and Volley only).

abilities.name: Scatter Shot
abilities.description: Tier 5, 1 rank: 'A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 seconds. Any damage caused will remove the effect.' Range 15 yd. Datamined as unchanged. Icy Veins: only useful in PvP. Warcraft Tavern: usable as a pseudo-interrupt.

abilities.name: Ranged Weapon Specialization
abilities.description: Tier 6, 5 ranks: +1-5% ranged weapon damage. Datamined as unchanged.

abilities.name: Sniper Shot
abilities.cost: 365 Mana at the rank shown in datamine (R2 L48)
abilities.description: New 31-point gold medal talent; requires Trueshot Aura. 'A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 160 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 seconds' (R1). Base range 45 yd. Datamined higher ranks: R2 at L48 (+225), R3 at L58 (+295). Auto Shot keeps firing during the cast. Icy Veins: 'possible this ability will actually be a damage loss in PvE'; strong burst opener.

abilities.name: Improved Tracking
abilities.description: New (merges Monster Slaying and Humanoid Slaying). 5 ranks: while tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids or Undead, +1-5% damage to that creature type.

abilities.name: Deflection
abilities.description: Tier 1, 5 ranks: +1-5% parry. Changed from 2/4/6/8/10% in the ~Oct 2 build (official).

abilities.name: Entrapment
abilities.description: Slight redesign: now always triggers when your trap triggers, and more ranks add duration instead of chance. 5 ranks root all affected targets for 1-5 s. Beta fixes: it has diminishing returns and triggers only on Frost Trap's first activation.

abilities.name: Savage Strikes
abilities.description: Redesigned, 2 ranks. Blizzard: 'increases all melee damage by 2/4%' (was Raptor Strike/Mongoose Bite only). The Icy Veins and Wowhead tooltips instead say +2/4% crit chance for all melee abilities. Wording conflict unresolved.

abilities.name: Survivalist
abilities.description: Moved up to row 2. 5 ranks: +2-10% total Health.

abilities.name: Improved Wing Clip
abilities.description: Now 3 ranks to reach the 20% max (7/13/20% chance for Wing Clip to immobilize for 5 s). Its proc chance was corrected on Oct 8, with a lower chance when using low ranks.

abilities.name: Clever Traps
abilities.description: Tier 3, 2 ranks: Freezing and Frost trap effects last 15/30% longer, and Immolation and Explosive trap damage rises 15/30%. Datamined as unchanged.

abilities.name: Surefooted
abilities.description: Moved up to row 3. 3 ranks: +1-3% hit with all attacks, and movement-impairing effects on you last 10-30% less.

abilities.name: Deterrence
abilities.description: Tier 3, 1 rank: +25% dodge and parry for 10 s. Datamined as unchanged. Required for Counterattack. Helps trigger Mongoose Bite and Counterattack.

abilities.name: Survival Tactics
abilities.description: Formerly Trap Mastery. 2 ranks: +5/10% hit chance for Traps and, newly, Feign Death.

abilities.name: Predator's Edge
abilities.description: New. 5 ranks: melee ability crit damage +6-30% and off-hand weapon damage +10-50% (the dual-wield enabler). The Oct 16 tooltip update clarifies the crit bonus applies only to abilities.

abilities.name: Counterattack
abilities.description: Now the 16-point gold medal talent, moved from row 5 to row 4; requires Deterrence. Usable after you parry: deals 50% weapon damage plus 26 and immobilizes the target for 5 s; cannot be blocked, dodged or parried. Now scales with weapon damage.

abilities.name: Resourcefulness
abilities.description: New; replaces Wyvern Sting, Killer Instinct and Improved Feign Death. 2 ranks: Trap and melee abilities cost 30/60% less mana, and melee and ranged ability crits have a 50/100% chance to let 50% of your mana regeneration continue while casting for 30 s. Since Oct 16 it triggers only on ability crits, not traps. Players report it bugged for much of the beta.

abilities.name: Expose Prey
abilities.description: New. 2 ranks: melee and ranged attacks on your Hunter's Mark target have a 5/10% chance to enable Mongoose Bite as if you had dodged; lasts 10 s (was 5 s before the ~Oct 8 build).

abilities.name: Survivalist's Discipline
abilities.description: New. 2 ranks: Trap and Deterrence cooldowns -20/40%.

abilities.name: Strider Kick
abilities.description: New 21-point gold medal talent: 'A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 seconds.' Range 5 yd. Not an interrupt (Wowhead). Usable while disarmed or with no main-hand weapon (Oct 16). Used to step out and weave ranged shots.

abilities.name: Lightning Reflexes
abilities.description: Tier 6, 5 ranks: +2-10% Agility; Blizzard lowered it to make room for new talents (Classic: 15%).

abilities.name: Lacerating Strikes
abilities.description: New 31-point gold medal talent; requires 2 points in Expose Prey. Mongoose Bite also makes the target bleed for 40% of the Mongoose Bite damage over 21 s. Can crit (beta fix).

abilities.name: Trickster's Dance (Fox)
abilities.description: Foxes are a new pet family. Their unique ability raises the pet's dodge chance and attack speed for 12 s. Diet: Fruit and Meat (Warcraft Tavern).

abilities.name: Sonic Blast (Bat)
abilities.description: Damage plus a spellcasting slow. Oct 16 nerf: cast-time increase 30% (was 60%), duration 20 s (was 30). Does not stack with Curse of Tongues or Mind-numbing Poison (Warcraft Tavern).

abilities.name: Swipe (Bear)
abilities.description: Damaging attack that hits 3 targets (datamined R1: 4 damage, R5: 20-22). Autocasts only against more than one target. Icy Veins recommends Bears for leveling AoE threat; its Survival author disagrees.

abilities.name: Mine! (Bird of Prey)
abilities.description: Damage plus a disarm, now 3 s (was 4). The family was formerly called Owl. Guides call it a PvP counter to weapon users.

abilities.name: Charge (Boar)
abilities.description: Charges to the target, immobilizes it, and gives Attack Power to the pet's next attack. Warcraft Tavern: autocasts only in Assist mode after you attack first.

abilities.name: Demoralizing Screech (Carrion Bird)
abilities.description: Renamed from Screech: damages nearby enemies and reduces their melee Attack Power. Does not stack with Demoralizing Roar.

abilities.name: Prowl (Cat)
abilities.description: Stealth that boosts the next attack from stealth. Listed as the Cat's unique ability.

abilities.name: Pinch (Crab)
abilities.description: Damage plus a 50% movement slow for 9 s (datamined R1: 19-21 damage).

abilities.name: Dismember (Crocolisk)
abilities.description: Damage plus a healing-received reduction, nerfed on Oct 16 to 25% (was 50%) for 6 s (was 10). Does not stack with Mortal Strike.

abilities.name: Thunderstomp (Gorilla)
abilities.description: Damages enemies in an area; Warcraft Tavern says rank 4 is new.

abilities.name: Tendon Rip (Hyena)
abilities.description: 50% movement slow plus a bleed over 9 s (datamined R1: 12 damage).

abilities.name: Savage Rend (Raptor)
abilities.description: Bleed over 18 s; the datamined tooltip adds +5% (R1) to +26% (R5) extra bleed damage taken.

abilities.name: Scorpid Poison (Scorpid)
abilities.description: Stacking damage over time (Wowhead: stacks to 5); listed as the Scorpid's unique ability.

abilities.name: Web (Spider)
abilities.description: Immobilizes the target and deals Nature damage over 4 s (datamined R1: 12, R5: 52).

abilities.name: Dust Cloud (Tallstrider)
abilities.description: Reduces target armor (datamined R1: 65, R5: 505) for 30 s. Does not stack with Faerie Fire. Wowhead calls it BM's only raid contribution beyond damage.

abilities.name: Shell Shield (Turtle)
abilities.description: Reduces the pet's damage taken and attack speed for 12 s.

abilities.name: Lightning Breath (Wind Serpent)
abilities.description: A damaging attack with 20 yd range; Warcraft Tavern recommends it for PvP.

abilities.name: Furious Howl (Wolf)
abilities.description: Raises the melee Attack Power of party members (datamine: within 15 yd for 1 min). Its AP bonus was cut 40% in the ~Sep 25 build. Does not stack with Battle Shout.

abilities.name: Lava Breath (Core Hound)
abilities.description: Warcraft Tavern says Core Hounds keep Lava Breath (originally from Season of Discovery). Blizzard's family list does not include Core Hound.

abilities.name: Growl (and shared pet abilities Bite, Claw, Dash, Dive, Cower)
abilities.description: Official: every family can learn Bite or Claw (sometimes both) and Dive or Dash. Growl (a threat ability, 'not a complete taunt') is the only active ability taught by the Pet Trainer, with ranks every 10 levels from 10. The trainer also teaches passives: Great Stamina, Natural Armor and resistances. Warcraft Tavern: Bite, Claw, Growl, Cower, Dash and Dive are otherwise unchanged.

facts.claim: Aimed Shot is now a baseline ability for all Hunters at level 20 (it was an MM talent in Classic).
facts.evidence: Blizzard: 'Aimed Shot is now granted as a baseline ability to all Hunters at level 20.'

facts.claim: Multi-Shot now shares a cooldown with Aimed Shot; Arcane Shot no longer shares a cooldown with Aimed Shot.
facts.evidence: Baseline list: 'Arcane Shot no longer shares a cooldown with Aimed Shot.' 'Multi-Shot now shares a cooldown with Aimed Shot.'

facts.claim: Traps work in combat, but trap cooldowns rose to 30 s, and Frost and Fire traps have separate cooldowns.
facts.evidence: 'Traps are now useable in combat, but their cooldown has increased to 30 seconds.' 'Frost-based and Fire-based traps now have separate cooldowns.'

facts.claim: Since the Oct 16 beta build, a Hunter can have 1 Fire trap and 1 Ice trap active at once, and Fire traps scale with Attack Power.
facts.evidence: Dev notes: Hunter 'may now correctly have 1 active Fire Trap and 1 active Ice Trap'; 'Fire traps now correctly scale with Attack Power.'

facts.claim: Traps can still only be placed at the Hunter's own location.
facts.evidence: Blizzard: Hunters have more utility with traps in combat 'but still can only place traps at their own location.'

facts.claim: The ranged dead zone remains: ranged abilities cannot be used within 8 yards of the enemy.
facts.evidence: 'Hunters' ranged abilities become unavailable in the "dead zone" within 8 yards of their enemy.'

facts.claim: Blizzard says Hunters have the longest range of any class but cannot Stun or Interrupt, and their only role is damage (the pet can tank solo and in small groups).
facts.evidence: 'Hunters only have one combat role, damage' ... 'longest range of any class' ... 'cannot Stun or Interrupt.'

facts.claim: Auto Shot requires standing still for 0.5 s before shooting (restored Oct 16 after an early-beta bug), but keeps firing while you cast Aimed Shot or Sniper Shot.
facts.evidence: 'Auto Shot now requires you to stand still for 0.5 seconds before shooting' ... 'will still fire Auto Shot while casting spells like Aimed Shot or Sniper Shot.'

facts.claim: Icy Veins says your abilities no longer clip or delay Auto Shot, so you don't need to time your rotation around the swing timer.
facts.evidence: 'your abilities will not clip your auto shots; you do not need to time your rotation around your auto shots.'

facts.claim: Pets now gain stats from the Hunter's gear and can no longer receive player buffs that raise their stats.
facts.evidence: 'Pets now get increased stats based on their Hunter's gear.' 'Pets can no longer receive player buffs that increase their stats.'

facts.claim: Guides give these pet scaling numbers: 10% of the Hunter's highest AP, 100% of crit chance, 30% of armor, 2 pet HP per player Stamina; pets also have avoidance now.
facts.evidence: Wowhead: 'Every 1 player Stamina gives the pet 2 Health'; '30% of the player's Armor'; '10% of the player's highest Attack Power'; '100% ... Crit'.

facts.claim: Pets inherit the higher of the Hunter's melee or ranged crit chance (bug fix) and benefit from Expertise.
facts.evidence: Oct 16 notes: fixed pets 'only ever inheriting the player's Melee Critical Strike chance instead of whichever is higher'; 'Pets now correctly benefit from Expertise.'

facts.claim: Every pet family gets one unique ability and can learn Bite or Claw and Dive or Dash. Foxes are a new family with Trickster's Dance.
facts.evidence: 'Every pet family can now learn either Bite or Claw' ... 'either Dive or Dash' ... 'one ability completely unique to that family'.

facts.claim: Pet Focus now regenerates continuously (retail-like) rather than in chunks, so pet abilities may wait on Focus between casts.
facts.evidence: Warcraft Tavern: pets 'use a more modern Focus system, regenerating Focus continuously rather than in chunks.'

facts.claim: Pet happiness and loyalty remain. Happiness changes pet damage (Happy 125%, Content 100%, Unhappy 75%), and loyalty has six ranks that grant Training Points (300 at level 60 with Best Friend).
facts.evidence: Icy Veins: 'Pet happiness and loyalty still exists; remember to feed your pet!' Warcraft Tavern lists Rebellious to Best Friend and 300 Training Points.

facts.claim: Taming unlocks at level 10 through the race-specific 'Taming the Beast' quest chain (three tames, then 'Training the Beast'). You can only tame beasts at or below your level.
facts.evidence: Dev notes: 'Tame Beast no longer works on Beasts that are higher than the Hunter's level.' Warcraft Tavern details the quest chain.

facts.claim: Higher pet ability ranks are still learned by taming a wild beast that knows that rank, using the ability until learned, then teaching it through Beast Training. Pets can have at most 4 active abilities.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins: 'you still need to go out and tame a higher level pet that already knows the skill ... Your pet will not naturally learn higher level abilities'.

facts.claim: Hunters own up to three pets (1 active, 2 stabled); players on the beta forums ask for more stable slots.
facts.evidence: Warcraft Tavern: 'In total, you can own up to three pets: One active pet ... Two stabled pets'.

facts.claim: Aggressive pet mode was restored during the beta; it is in the pet tab of the spellbook.
facts.evidence: 'Aggressive Mode has been brought back and can be found under the pet tab in your spell book.'

facts.claim: The Oct 16 build nerfed the strongest PvP pet abilities: Dismember (25% healing reduction, 6 s, 15 s cooldown), Sonic Blast (30% cast slow, 20 s, 60 s cooldown) and Mine! (3 s disarm, 90 s cooldown).
facts.evidence: 'Dismember (Crocolisk): Healing reduction reduced to 25% (was 50%) ... Cooldown increased to 15 seconds (was 6 seconds).'

facts.claim: Hunters use Mana (not Focus) and are bound by the 5-second rule. Each spec now has a talent that keeps mana regenerating in combat: Bestial Discipline (BM), Rapid Recuperation (MM), Resourcefulness (Survival).
facts.evidence: Bestial Discipline 'Now also grants the Hunter Mana regeneration from Spirit while casting spells'; Rapid Recuperation and Resourcefulness grant similar regeneration.

facts.claim: Guides say most leveling damage comes passively from Auto Shot and the pet, so the best way to handle mana is to keep attacking rather than drink.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins: 'Even without pressing a single ability, you are still more than capable of killing any normal enemy you face.'

facts.claim: Lone Wolf (MM 11-point gold medal) gives +20% damage with all attacks while you have no active pet.
facts.evidence: 'Lone Wolf: (New 11-point gold medal talent.) Grants the Hunter 20% increased damage with all attacks while the Hunter has no active pet.'

facts.claim: Summon Hawk (BM 16-point gold medal) deals instant damage and summons a hawk for 18 s; you can have up to 2 hawks, and it shares a cooldown with Arcane Shot.
facts.evidence: 'Summon Hawk ... summons a Hawk to attack the Hunter's current target for 18 sec ... up to 2 Hawks ... Cooldown shared with Arcane Shot.'

facts.claim: Sniper Shot (MM 31-point gold medal) has a 4 s cast, 15 s cooldown and 45 yd base range, hits harder than Aimed Shot, and adds 10 yd range to your next 3 Shots.
facts.evidence: '4 second cast time and 15 second cooldown that deals even more damage than Aimed Shot ... base range of 45 yards'.

facts.claim: Trueshot Aura is raid-wide since the Oct 16 build. In Forever it buffs only Ranged Attack Power (the Classic version also gave melee AP).
facts.evidence: Oct 16 notes: 'Trueshot Aura is now Raid wide.' Warcraft Tavern: it now affects 'only ... Ranged Attack Power'.

facts.claim: Guides describe Survival as a primarily melee, dual-wield spec. Blizzard frames it as trap and melee build options that let you move between ranged and melee.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins: 'Survival is now designed to be a primarily melee based spec ... specifically while dual-wielding.'

facts.claim: Survival's new talents: Strider Kick (21-point), Lacerating Strikes (31-point), Expose Prey, Predator's Edge, Resourcefulness and Survivalist's Discipline. Counterattack is the 16-point talent.
facts.evidence: Blizzard lists 'Strider Kick: New 21-point gold medal talent' and 'Lacerating Strikes: New 31-point gold medal talent'.

facts.claim: Wyvern Sting, Killer Instinct and Improved Feign Death were removed and folded into Resourcefulness. Monster Slaying and Humanoid Slaying became Improved Tracking.
facts.evidence: 'Removed talents: Wyvern Sting, Killer Instinct, Improved Feign Death have now been combined into a new Resourcefulness talent'.

facts.claim: Talents start at level 10 with the same number of rows as Classic and one-point milestones at 11, 21 and 31 points, plus a new 16-point milestone. Respec at a city class trainer; Dual Specialization unlocks at level 40.
facts.evidence: 'one-point milestone talents at 11, 21, and 31 points, now joined by a new 16-point milestone' ... 'Dual Specialization also becomes available at level 40.'

facts.claim: Legacy points can grant up to 5 extra talent points and unlock talents up to 5 levels early (e.g. Summon Hawk at 20 instead of 25).
facts.evidence: Warcraft Tavern: 'investing points into Talented through the Legacy system allows you to unlock talents up to 5 levels earlier.'

facts.claim: Scorpid Sting now lowers the target's chance to hit by 2% instead of reducing Strength and Agility.
facts.evidence: 'Scorpid Sting now reduces the target's chance to hit by 2% instead of reducing the target's Strength and Agility.'

facts.claim: Disengage's threat reduction was doubled (in game from the ~Oct 8 build). It is still a threat drop, not a leap.
facts.evidence: 'Disengage: Threat reduction was intended to be doubled but was missed. Now implemented.'

facts.claim: Aspect of the Beast now also grants melee Attack Power (datamined +50 to +110), and the datamine shows it is learned at level 30.
facts.evidence: 'Aspect of the Beast now also grants melee Attack Power.'

facts.claim: Datamine shows Rapid Fire now increases both ranged and melee attack speed by 40% for 15 s (5 min cooldown).
facts.evidence: Forever tooltip: 'Increases ranged and melee attack speed by 40% for 15 sec.' Classic: ranged only.

facts.claim: Beast Mastery is rated the best leveling spec. Survival is the weakest early on and plays as a ranged Hunter until its deep melee talents arrive.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins: 'If you level as Survival, you will still need to play as a ranged DPS for at least the first 40 levels if not more.'

facts.claim: Beta players report Hunters as very strong from 10 to 30. One player hit 30 in about 22 hours /played, the fastest of the classes they tried.
facts.evidence: Forum post: 'I went 1-30 in just over 22 hours /played, the fastest of any class I tried on the beta.'

facts.claim: Guides say mounts aren't available before level 40, so Aspect of the Cheetah (L20) plus Pathfinding is the Hunter's main early mobility.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins: 'we will not have access to mounts before Level 40.'

facts.claim: Hunters can wear Mail from level 40, use polearms from level 20, and still need ammo and a quiver or ammo pouch.
facts.evidence: Warcraft Tavern: 'can learn to use Mail armor at level 40'; Wowhead: 'You will still use a quiver for arrows or an ammo pouch for bullets.'

facts.claim: Icy Veins' raid overview says world buffs are stripped inside Forever raids. Its Hunter overview argues this helps Hunters, who gained least from world buffs in Classic.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins: 'Hunters benefit by far the least from world buffs ... it will be a huge advantage for Hunter's end-game raid viability.'

facts.claim: Level-60 raids open December 9: Barrow Deeps (10), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40). Molten Core is not a launch raid.
facts.evidence: Blizzard (quoted by Icy Veins): 'On December 9, level 60 players can ... three raids: Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit, and Onyxia's Lair.'

facts.claim: Warcraft Tavern gives a 9% effective hit cap against bosses at 300 weapon skill (6% at 305). Agility gives 2 Ranged AP and 1 melee AP, and about 53 Agility gives 1% crit at level 60.
facts.evidence: 'At level 60, with 300 weapon skill, Hunters have an effective Hit cap of 9% against bosses.' 'every 53 Agility grants 1% Crit Chance.'

facts.claim: Human Hunters are new in Forever. Hunter races are Human, Night Elf, Dwarf and Skyborne (Alliance) and Orc, Troll, Tauren and Skyborne (Horde); Undead cannot be Hunters.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins: 'Alliance Hunters ... Human, Night Elf, Dwarf, and the new race Skyborne. For the Horde ... Orc, Troll, Tauren, and Skyborne.'

facts.claim: Oct 16 racial changes: Human Sword Specialization became Ruthless (+2% crit), Dwarf Mace Specialization became Earth Fury (+2% crit damage), Orc Axe Specialization became Savage (+1% crit) and Blood Fury went to a 3 min cooldown, Tauren Endurance gives +2% crit damage, Skyborne Wind Blessed gives 3% haste.
facts.evidence: Warcraft Tavern summary of the Oct 16 notes: Human 'Sword Specialization is replaced with Ruthless, granting 2% increased critical strike chance.'

facts.claim: Feign Death drops threat, but nearby enemies still attack your pet. Guides use it to reset pulls back to the tank, and Wowhead notes it allows out-of-combat gear swaps.
facts.evidence: Icy Veins: Feign Death makes enemies 'drop threat ... However, they will still attack your pet if it is alive and nearby.'

facts.claim: Pets get campfire (Camping) buffs if summoned while you sit at the campfire.
facts.evidence: Warcraft Tavern: 'pets also benefit from Camping buffs, provided they are summoned while you're sitting beside the campfire.'

facts.claim: Pet XP is 25% of the XP you earn from green-or-higher mobs (no rested or quest XP), and pets stop leveling at your level.
facts.evidence: Warcraft Tavern: 'Your pet receives 25% of the experience you earn from each mob, provided the mob is green level or higher.'

facts.claim: Warcraft Tavern says pet damage is normalized by attack speed within a family in PvE, so a fast cat and a slow cat deal similar overall damage.
facts.evidence: 'Pet family damage is normalized in PvE, meaning that faster attacks deal less damage per hit while slower attacks deal more'.

facts.claim: Some beta players argue melee weaving beats pure ranged or pure melee by about 20-30% in early sims; others dispute this. Nobody has tested level 60.
facts.evidence: Forum users cite 'preliminary sims' showing weaving ahead by about 20-30%; another replies 'nobody has reached 60'.

facts.claim: Datamined client data also contains Readiness (resets all other Hunter cooldowns) and a Survival 'Lacerate' bleed spell, but neither appears in any Forever talent tree or guide.
facts.evidence: Wowhead spellbook diff lists Readiness (updated text) and Lacerate (new, 4 ranks from L30); no guide lists them as usable.

levelingNotes: Level ~1-10: no pet yet. Guides call this 'a relatively slow start'. You kite backward or strafe, get as many Auto Shots off as possible (after the Oct 16 build you must stand still 0.5 s per shot), then finish with Raptor Strike and melee. New buttons arrive quickly: Aspect of the Monkey and Serpent Sting at 4, Arcane Shot and Hunter's Mark at 6, Concussive Shot at 8. Level 10 is the big unlock. The race-specific 'Taming the Beast' chain (three tames) gives Tame Beast, then 'Training the Beast' gives Beast Training, Feed Pet and Revive Pet. You also get the first talent point and Aspect of the Hawk. From then on the pet tanks with Growl while you shoot, and Icy Veins calls the pet 'the single greatest leveling tool that any class gets'. More arrives at 12 (Mend Pet, Wing Clip, Distracting Shot), 14 (Scare Beast, Eagle Eye, Eyes of the Beast), 16 (Immolation Trap, Mongoose Bite) and 18 (Multi-Shot). Level 20 brings baseline Aimed Shot, Aspect of the Cheetah, Freezing Trap, Disengage and polearms, plus the 11-point talents (Lone Wolf). The 16-point talents (Summon Hawk, Trueshot Aura, Counterattack) come at 25, or 20 with Legacy points. Then Rapid Fire (26) and Frost Trap (28). Level ~30 (the beta cap): Feign Death, Aspect of the Beast and the 21-point tier (Intimidation, Rapid Recuperation, Strider Kick, Expose Prey, Resourcefulness, Scatter Shot). Guides and players describe Hunters, especially BM, as dominant from 10 to 30. One beta player reported 1-30 in about 22 hours /played. The loop is to send the pet in, Serpent Sting, Aimed Shot or hawks, and keep Auto Shot running. Downtime is mostly mana, which you handle by letting autos and the pet kill rather than drinking. MM spends more of its own mana (Rapid Killing plus Rapid Recuperation fixes most of it) and pulls threat off the pet more often. Survival only becomes a credible melee spec at about 30, with Savage Strikes, 5/5 Predator's Edge and Strider Kick. It burns mana and pulls threat with melee crits, and guides call it the weakest leveler. Mounts aren't available before 40, so Cheetah plus Pathfinding is the movement tool. Later: Explosive Trap at 34, Viper Sting at 36. Level 40 brings Mail, riding, Dual Spec, Aspect of the Pack, Volley and the 31-point capstones (Bestial Wrath, Sniper Shot, Lacerating Strikes). Aspect of the Wild at 46, Tranquilizing Shot listed at 60 (source unclear). Level ~60: no tested data. Icy Veins says it can't give advice past 30 until launch, and Warcraft Tavern's level-60 builds (BM 31/20/0, MM 5/46/0) are theoretical. Ongoing chores: ammo and bag space, feeding the pet, learning pet ranks by taming, and keeping the pet alive.
groupRoleNotes: Role: physical DPS only, ranged for BM and MM, melee for Survival. Crowd control: Freezing Trap (single-target freeze, 10-20 s, now placeable in combat), Frost Trap (60% AoE slow, plus Entrapment roots for Survival), Scatter Shot (MM talent, 4 s disorient), Intimidation (BM pet stun, 3 s), Scare Beast (beasts only), and Wing Clip, Concussive Shot, Improved Concussive Shot and Improved Wing Clip procs. Blizzard says Hunters 'cannot Stun or Interrupt'. Talented Intimidation and Scatter Shot are the only stand-ins; Strider Kick is not an interrupt. Dispels: none on allies. Tranquilizing Shot removes Frenzy (and, per guides, Enrage) from enemies, which matters in raids, though how Forever teaches it is unconfirmed. Improved Mend Pet cleanses only your own pet. Buffs and debuffs: Trueshot Aura is raid-wide, ranged AP only. A Wolf's Furious Howl buffs party melee AP (doesn't stack with Battle Shout), and a Tallstrider's Dust Cloud lowers armor (doesn't stack with Faerie Fire). Hunter's Mark adds ranged AP against the target. Aspect of the Pack and Aspect of the Wild help the group. Flare and Track Hidden counter stealth, which Warcraft Tavern says matters for Stratholme's Eye of Naxxramas. Scorpid Sting cuts the target's hit by 2%. Wowhead's overview pages (written before Trueshot Aura went raid-wide) say Hunters bring little group utility and earn spots on damage. Pulling: long range plus Feign Death to drop aggro and hand mobs to the tank. Eyes of the Beast and Distracting Shot also help. Disengage lowers threat. Risks: tanks and guides warn that an uncontrolled pet (left on Stay or Aggressive), AoE before the tank has aggro, and pets with weak AoE threat can pull or wipe groups. Guides say Hunter AoE is limited to Multi-Shot (3 targets, shares a cooldown with Aimed Shot), Explosive Trap (now usable in combat and scaling with AP) and Volley. Icy Veins rates MM, with Lone Wolf and Trueshot Aura, as the best dungeon AoE spec at 30. Survival has little AoE beyond Explosive Trap. Players worry that pets and hawks will die to raid AoE, which pushes some toward MM or Lone Wolf for raids.
pvpNotes: Guides consider Hunters strong at kiting. You have the longest range of any class, plus Sniper Shot's 45 yd and its +10 yd to the next shots, and Hawk Eye adds up to 6 yd. Concussive Shot ('one of the strongest tools a Hunter has in PvP', Icy Veins), Frost Trap and Wing Clip back this up, and Wowhead calls kiting strong 'as long as they don't have access to ranged CC or gap closers'. Arcane Shot, Serpent Sting, Summon Hawk and Concussive Shot work while moving. Auto Shot needs 0.5 s stationary, and Aimed Shot (2 s) and Sniper Shot (4 s) casts are hard to land under pressure. The dead zone (8 yd) remains a weakness against melee. Survival's melee tools (Counterattack root, Deterrence, Strider Kick speed) help it stick to targets and counter melee. Counters and tools: Viper Sting (mana drain, now 15 s cooldown), Scatter Shot (disorient), Freezing Trap (now usable in combat), Scare Beast (vs pets and druid forms), Hunter's Mark, Flare and Track Hidden against Rogues and Druids, and Feign Death to drop targeting. Pet PvP utility: Dismember gives healing reduction (nerfed to 25% for 6 s), Sonic Blast slows casting (nerfed), Mine! disarms (nerfed to 3 s on a 90 s cooldown), Web roots, and a Wind Serpent's Lightning Breath works at range. Wowhead suggests double hawks plus a Bestial Wrath pet as BM burst, but notes hawks have very little health. Race picks per guides: Human (Will to Survive is a separate stun break) or Dwarf (Stoneform) for Alliance; Orc (Hardiness, Blood Fury) and Tauren (War Stomp) for Horde. Engineering grenades are suggested for PvP. Format: no Arenas. Battlegrounds are Warsong Gulch (10-60), Arathi Basin, the new Darkspear Islands (15v15, 30-60) and Alterac Valley, with a seasonal rank system without decay and world PvP. No PvP tier list or level-60 PvP data exists yet. Beta forums argued over Hunter pet utility before the nerfs, with one player summarizing that 'Hunters were simply gaining too much utility'.
openQuestions: Final launch numbers: as of 2026-10-25 no launch patch notes were found. Everything above comes from the level-30 beta and Blizzard's Sept 30 deep dive, which Blizzard says 'may continue to evolve'.
Aimed Shot cast time: 2 s in Wowhead's latest datamine and guides, 3 s in warcraft.wiki.gg's Forever tooltip.
Volley cooldown: Wowhead says none in Forever (was 1 min); warcraft.wiki.gg shows 1 min.
Trueshot Aura placement: Blizzard calls it 'the 21-point gold medal' but also says 'row 4'; Icy Veins shows it requires 15 points (available at 25).
Savage Strikes: Blizzard says it raises all melee damage by 2/4%; the Icy Veins and Wowhead tooltips say +2/4% melee ability crit.
How is Tranquilizing Shot learned in Forever? It is listed at level 60, but in Classic it came from a Molten Core tome, and Molten Core is not a launch raid.
Readiness and 'Lacerate' exist in datamined data but in no talent tree or guide. Are they usable?
Warcraft Tavern's Hunter guide mentions 'Misdirection', but it is not in the datamined Forever Hunter spellbook. It is probably not in the game.
Pet classification: Icy Veins says Ferocity, Cunning or Tenacity with no damage modifier; Warcraft Tavern says Offensive, Balanced or Defensive with different DPS and tankiness.
Pet Stamina scaling: Wowhead says 2 pet HP per player Stamina; the Icy Veins Survival guide says Stamina raises 'your pet's health by 10'.
Pet commands: officially only Aggressive mode's return is confirmed. Warcraft Tavern mentions an 'Assist' setting and a 'Move To' command; the full Forever command set is unconfirmed.
Was pet happiness decay fully fixed? It was bugged for much of the beta (only decreased on death).
Level-60 rotations are untested. Is Sniper Shot's 4 s cast a DPS gain in PvE? Is melee weaving optimal for all specs? Will pets and hawks survive raid AoE?
Survival at 60: no published level-60 rotation or build, and Warcraft Tavern has no Survival guide.
Blizzard says Hunters 'cannot Stun or Interrupt', yet talents give a pet stun (Intimidation), a stun proc (Improved Concussive Shot) and a disorient (Scatter Shot). How should the game present this?
Exact talent-tier unlock levels assume the Classic pattern (tier N at 10 + 5*(N-1)), matching Warcraft Tavern's milestone table; total points at 60 reported as 51.
